title: When AI Takes Sides on Questions of Faith: Persistent Asymmetries in AI-Mediated Faith Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating user queries about transitioning between 14 different religious affiliations (including non-theistic identities like Atheism and Agnosticism) and evaluating the asymmetry in the models' supportiveness or discouragement for joining versus leaving each religion using a human-verified LLM-as-a-judge framework.
